assist-empty: The assistant wrote nothing. Try again.
assist-failed: The assistant stopped before it finished.
assist-note: DeepSeek writes into the body below. Nothing is saved until you save.
assist-offline: The assistant is offline. Check DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
assist-placeholder-edit: Say what to change, such as "add a section on scoring".
assist-placeholder-new: Say what the page should cover.
assist-rate-limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment.
assist-unconfigured: Set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY to turn the assistant on.
delete-description: "{{title}}" will be removed from the wiki.
edit-conflict: Someone else saved this page since you opened it. Copy your text, reopen the page and apply it again.
empty-description: Add the starter pages, or write the first page yourself.
link-description: Create, edit and delete the pages on wiki.rmhstudios.com, with a DeepSeek writing assistant.
seed-failed: Could not add the starter pages.
seeded-none: Every starter page is already on the wiki.
setup-mediawiki: Run wiki-bootstrap in the mediawiki container, set the MEDIAWIKI_BOT_USER and MEDIAWIKI_BOT_PASSWORD it prints, and restart the web service. The steps are in docs/wiki.md.
title-fixed: Rename a page on the wiki itself.
title-hint: The title is also the address. A slash makes a sub-page.
title-taken: A page with that title already exists.
unreachable-mediawiki: Check that the mediawiki service is running and that MEDIAWIKI_URL and the bot password are correct.
